  <NavRailItem icon={<Settings />} label="Settings" href="/settings" />
</NavRail>

side-rail.name: Side Rail
side-rail.description: A floating glass rail that expands from an icon strip to a full label list on hover or focus.

ecosystem-rail.name: Ecosystem Rail
ecosystem-rail.description: A persistent cross-product rail with a stable Home destination, caller-filtered applications, and honest health status.
ecosystem-rail.usage:
<EcosystemRail

    { id: 'yang', label: 'Yang Operations', href: 'https://yang.example', icon: <Gauge />, current: true },
    { id: 'photos', label: 'Photos', href: 'https://photos.example', icon: <Camera />, status: 'degraded' },
  ]}
/>

top-bar.name: Top Bar
top-bar.description: A sticky top bar with brand, search, and action slots.

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: A hierarchical trail with router-ready items and automatic middle-item collapse.
breadcrumb.usage:
<Breadcrumb
  items={[
    { label: 'Workspace', href: '/' },
    { label: 'Projects', href: '/projects' },
    { label: 'Orion' },
  ]}
/>

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: A numbered flow indicator with done, current, and upcoming states.

tree-view.name: Tree View
tree-view.description: A hierarchical disclosure list with keyboard navigation and selection.
tree-view.usage:
<TreeView
  aria-label="Project files"
  items={[
    { id: 'src', label: 'src', children: [{ id: 'app', label: 'App.tsx' }] },
  ]}
/>

menubar.name: Menubar
menubar.description: An application command bar of labeled dropdown menus with full keyboard navigation.
menubar.usage:
<Menubar
  label="Application"
  menus={[
    { label: 'File', items: [{ id: 'new', label: 'New project', onSelect: () => undefined }] },
    { label: 'Edit', items: [{ id: 'undo', label: 'Undo', onSelect: () => undefined }] },
  ]}
/>

navigation-menu.name: Navigation Menu
navigation-menu.description: A top-level navigation bar mixing links with rich content panels in a shared viewport.
navigation-menu.usage:
<NavigationMenu
  label="Primary"
  items={[
    { type: 'link', label: 'Overview', href: '/', active: true },
    { type: 'panel', label: 'Products', content: <ProductsPanel /> },
  ]}
/>

back-top.name: Back Top
back-top.description: A floating button that appears after scrolling and returns to the top of the page.

anchor-nav.name: Anchor Nav
anchor-nav.description: A scroll-spy nav of page section anchors that highlights the section in view and smooth-scrolls on click.
anchor-nav.usage:
<AnchorNav
  items={[
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
    { id: 'features', label: 'Features' },
    { id: 'pricing', label: 'Pricing' },
  ]}
/>

bottom-nav.name: Bottom Nav
bottom-nav.description: A mobile bottom navigation bar of three to five icon-and-label items with aria-current and safe-area padding.
bottom-nav.usage:
<BottomNav>
  <BottomNavItem active href="/home" icon={<Home />} label="Home" />
  <BottomNavItem href="/search" icon={<Search />} label="Search" />
  <BottomNavItem badge={3} href="/alerts" icon={<Bell />} label="Alerts" />
  <BottomNavItem href="/profile" icon={<User />} label="Profile" />
</BottomNav>

dock.name: Dock
dock.description: A macOS-style dock of icon buttons with hover tooltips, accessible names, and an active-app indicator dot.
dock.usage:
<Dock>
  <DockItem active icon={<Mail />} label="Mail" />
  <DockItem icon={<Music />} label="Music" />
  <DockItem icon={<Folder />} label="Files" />
</Dock>

floating-toolbar.name: Floating Toolbar
floating-toolbar.description: A floating contextual toolbar that appears near a selection or anchored element, with roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation.
floating-toolbar.usage:
<FloatingToolbar open={hasSelection} className="left-1/2 top-2 -translate-x-1/2">
  <button aria-label="Bold"><Bold /></button>
  <button aria-label="Italic"><Italic /></button>
  <button aria-label="Underline"><Underline /></button>
</FloatingToolbar>

mega-menu.name: Mega Menu
mega-menu.description: A top-level navigation item that opens a multi-column link panel on hover, focus, or click, with full keyboard support.
mega-menu.usage:
<MegaMenu>
  <MegaMenuItem label="Products">
    <MegaMenuColumn heading="Build">
      <MegaMenuLink href="/editor">Editor</MegaMenuLink>
      <MegaMenuLink href="/preview">Preview</MegaMenuLink>
    </MegaMenuColumn>
    <MegaMenuColumn heading="Ship">
      <MegaMenuLink href="/hosting">Hosting</MegaMenuLink>
    </MegaMenuColumn>
  </MegaMenuItem>
</MegaMenu>

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.description: A full app sidebar with header, content, and footer slots that collapses to an icon rail, with aria-current on the active item.
sidebar.usage:
<Sidebar>
  <SidebarHeader>
    <Logo />
  </SidebarHeader>
  <SidebarContent>
    <SidebarSection label="Workspace">
      <SidebarItem active href="/overview" icon={<LayoutDashboard />}>
        Overview
      </SidebarItem>
      <SidebarItem href="/projects" icon={<FolderKanban />}>
        Projects
      </SidebarItem>
    </SidebarSection>
  </SidebarContent>
  <SidebarFooter>
    <SidebarCollapseButton />
  </SidebarFooter>
</Sidebar>

skip-link.name: Skip Link
skip-link.description: A visually-hidden-until-focused "Skip to content" link that becomes the first tab stop of the page.

sub-nav.name: Sub Nav
sub-nav.description: A secondary horizontal nav row with an underline indicator for the active item that scrolls when items overflow.
sub-nav.usage:
<SubNav aria-label="Project settings">
  <SubNavItem active href="#general">General</SubNavItem>
  <SubNavItem href="#members">Members</SubNavItem>
  <SubNavItem href="#billing">Billing</SubNavItem>
</SubNav>

table-of-contents.name: Table of Contents
table-of-contents.description: A nested list of heading links that indents by heading level and highlights the section in view with an IntersectionObserver.
table-of-contents.usage:
<TableOfContents
  headings={[
    { id: 'installation', level: 2, title: 'Installation' },
    { id: 'npm', level: 3, title: 'With npm' },
    { id: 'usage', level: 2, title: 'Usage' },
  ]}
/>

permission-matrix.name: Permission Matrix
permission-matrix.description: A people-by-applications access matrix with caller-supplied cell content and explicit no-access cells.
permission-matrix.usage:
<PermissionMatrix
  caption="Household application access"
  columns={[
    { id: 'photos', label: 'Photos' },
    { id: 'trict', label: 'Trict' },
  ]}
  rows={[
    { id: 'avery', label: 'Avery', cells: { photos: <Badge variant="success">Owner</Badge> } },
  ]}
/>

table.name: Table
table.description: Accessible data presentation driven by column definitions, density, loading, and empty state.
table.usage:
<Table
  caption="Team members"
  columns={[{ key: 'name', header: 'Name', cell: (row) => row.name }]}
  rows={rows}
  getRowKey={(row) => row.id}
/>

separator.name: Separator
separator.description: A semantic or decorative divider for related content.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.description: A compact identity image with initials and icon fallbacks.

description-list.name: Description List
description-list.description: A label/value definition list for detail pages, stacked or two-column.
description-list.usage:
<DescriptionList
  items={[
    { label: 'Owner', value: 'Avery Chen' },
    { label: 'Created', value: 'March 4, 2026' },
  ]}
/>

data-table.name: Data Table
data-table.description: A data grid with sortable columns and row selection, built on the Table contract.
data-table.usage:
<DataTable
  caption="Projects"
  columns={[{ key: 'name', header: 'Name', cell: (row) => row.name, sortable: true }]}
  rows={rows}
  getRowKey={(row) => row.id}
  sort={sort}
  onSortChange={setSort}
  selectable
/>

avatar-group.name: Avatar Group
avatar-group.description: An overlapping identity stack with an overflow count.

stat.name: Stat
stat.description: A labeled metric with a trend delta and optional supporting content.
stat.usage:
<Stat
  label="Monthly recurring revenue"
  value="$48.2k"
  delta={{ direction: 'up', value: '+12.4%' }}
  description="vs. previous month"
/>

list.name: List
list.description: A vertical item list with leading and trailing slots, secondary text, and a dense mode.
list.usage:
<List>
  <ListItem leading={<Folder />} title="Reports" secondary="12 files" trailing="2 GB" />
  <ListItem title="Archive" onClick={() => undefined} />
</List>

sparkline.name: Sparkline
sparkline.description: A tiny inline trend chart in line, area, or bar form with an accessible summary.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: A month grid for picking a single date with bounds and disabled days.
calendar.usage:
const [date, setDate] = useState(new Date())

<Calendar value={date} onSelect={setDate} />

result.name: Result
result.description: A full-area outcome state for success, error, and HTTP results with a standard icon and actions.
result.usage:
<Result
  status="404"
  title="Page not found"
  description="The report may have been moved or deleted."
  actions={<Button>Back to projects</Button>}
/>

activity-feed.name: Activity Feed
activity-feed.description: Chronological list of actor-plus-action events with avatars or icons and timestamps, optionally grouped under day headings.
activity-feed.usage:
<ActivityFeed
  label="Project activity"
  groupByDay
  items={[
    { id: "1", actor: "Ada Lovelace", action: "merged the parser rewrite", timestamp: new Date() },
  ]}
/>

area-chart.name: Area Chart
area-chart.description: Line chart with a filled area under each series, an adjustable fill opacity, and a stacked mode for part-to-whole trends.
area-chart.usage:
<AreaChart
  label="Stacked sessions by channel"
  labels={['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr']}
  series={[
    { name: 'Organic', data: [80, 95, 90, 110] },
    { name: 'Paid', data: [20, 25, 22, 30] },
  ]}
  stacked
  opacity={0.5}
/>

bar-chart.name: Bar Chart
bar-chart.description: Grouped SVG bar chart with vertical or horizontal bars, optional value labels, a legend, and a built-in accessible data table.
bar-chart.usage:
<BarChart
  label="Revenue and costs per quarter"
  labels={['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4']}
  series={[
    { name: 'Revenue', data: [42, 55, 48, 61] },
    { name: 'Costs', data: [30, 34, 32, 38] },
  ]}
  showValues
/>

calendar-heatmap.name: Calendar Heatmap
calendar-heatmap.description: GitHub-style year calendar heatmap with weeks-by-weekday cells, a 0–4 level color scale, and month labels.
calendar-heatmap.usage:
<CalendarHeatmap
  aria-label="Commit activity in 2025"
  year={2025}
  data={[{ date: "2025-03-14", level: 3 }]}
/>

chart-container.name: Chart Container
chart-container.description: Accessible SVG frame for hand-rolled charts with an aria-label summary, a toggleable screen-reader data table, and reusable axis, grid, and legend primitives.
chart-container.usage:
<ChartContainer
  label="Visits per weekday"
  columns={[
    { key: 'day', label: 'Day' },
    { key: 'visits', label: 'Visits' },
  ]}
  data={rows}
>
  <ChartGrid positions={[40, 90, 140]} start={44} end={404} />
  <ChartAxis orientation="x" offset={190} start={44} end={404} ticks={ticks} />
</ChartContainer>

comment-thread.name: Comment Thread
comment-thread.description: Nested comment list with author avatars, timestamps, caller-wired reply buttons, and collapsible reply threads.
comment-thread.usage:
<CommentThread
  comments={[
    {
      id: "1",
      author: "Ada Lovelace",
      body: "Looks good overall.",
      timestamp: new Date(),
      replies: [{ id: "1a", author: "Alan Turing", body: "Needs tests." }],
    },
  ]}
  onReply={(comment) => openComposer(comment.id)}
/>

diff-viewer.name: Diff Viewer
diff-viewer.description: Line-based diff view with added/removed/context coloring, a +/- gutter, and old/new line numbers.

funnel-chart.name: Funnel Chart
funnel-chart.description: SVG funnel of stages whose widths follow their values, with stage-to-stage conversion percentages.
funnel-chart.usage:
<FunnelChart
  aria-label="Signup conversion funnel"
  stages={[
    { name: "Visited", value: 10000 },
    { name: "Signed up", value: 3200 },
    { name: "Paid", value: 480 },
  ]}
/>

gantt-chart.name: Gantt Chart
gantt-chart.description: A read-only SVG Gantt chart that plots task bars on a day grid with a today marker.
gantt-chart.usage:
<GanttChart
  label="Release plan"
  tasks={[
    { id: 'design', label: 'Design', start: '2025-03-03', end: '2025-03-07' },
    { id: 'build', label: 'Build', start: '2025-03-10', end: '2025-03-19' },
  ]}
/>

gauge-chart.name: Gauge Chart
gauge-chart.description: Semicircle SVG gauge with min/max scale, threshold zones, and a centered value label.
gauge-chart.usage:
<GaugeChart
  aria-label="Latency score"

  label="Latency score"
  thresholds={[{ upTo: 50 }, { upTo: 80 }, { upTo: 100 }]}
/>

heatmap.name: Heatmap
heatmap.description: Matrix heatmap that maps values to a color scale with row/column labels and cell tooltips.
heatmap.usage:
<Heatmap

/>

json-viewer.name: JSON Viewer

/>

kanban-board.name: Kanban Board

    { id: 'todo', title: 'To do', cards: [{ id: 'a', title: 'Design tokens' }] },

  onColumnsChange={(columns) => undefined}
/>

line-chart.name: Line Chart
line-chart.description: Multi-series SVG line chart with axis ticks, focusable points, simple or custom tooltips, a legend, and a built-in accessible data table.
line-chart.usage:
<LineChart
  label="Revenue and costs per month"
  labels={['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr']}
  series={[
    { name: 'Revenue', data: [42, 55, 48, 61] },
    { name: 'Costs', data: [30, 34, 32, 38] },
  ]}
/>

log-viewer.name: Log Viewer
log-viewer.description: Scrollable monospace log pane with severity coloring, a follow/auto-scroll toggle, and optional search highlighting.
log-viewer.usage:
<LogViewer
  label="Deploy logs"
  lines={[
    { id: "1", level: "info", message: "build started", timestamp: "10:00:01" },

  ]}
  search="failed"
/>

markdown-view.name: Markdown View
markdown-view.description: Renders a safe markdown subset — headings, emphasis, links, lists, code, and quotes — as teal-styled elements with no raw HTML.
markdown-view.usage:
<MarkdownView
  content={"## Release notes

Ships the **parser rewrite**.

- Faster tokens
- Inline `diff`"}
/>

org-chart.name: Org Chart
org-chart.description: A hierarchy of person nodes rendered as connected boxes, with collapsible subtrees.
org-chart.usage:
<OrgChart
  root={{
    id: 'ceo',
    name: 'Ada',
    title: 'CEO',
    children: [{ id: 'cto', name: 'Ben', title: 'CTO' }],
  }}
/>

pie-chart.name: Pie Chart
pie-chart.description: SVG pie and donut chart with keyboard-focusable segments, percentage labels, a legend, and a built-in accessible data table.
pie-chart.usage:
<PieChart
  label="Budget share per department"
  data={[
    { name: 'Engineering', value: 45 },
    { name: 'Design', value: 20 },
    { name: 'Marketing', value: 25 },
  ]}
  innerRadius={0.6}
/>

qr-code.name: QR Code
qr-code.description: Dependency-free SVG QR code renderer with a hand-rolled byte-mode encoder (error-correction level L).
qr-code.usage:
<QrCode
  value="https://example.com/app/invite"
  label="QR code for the invite link"
  size={160}
/>

radar-chart.name: Radar Chart
radar-chart.description: SVG radar (spider) chart that overlays multi-series polygons across a shared set of axes.
radar-chart.usage:
<RadarChart
  aria-label="Skill profiles"
  axes={["Frontend", "Backend", "Testing", "DevOps"]}
  series={[{ name: "Ada", values: [5, 3, 4, 2] }]}
/>

scatter-chart.name: Scatter Chart
scatter-chart.description: Hand-rolled SVG scatter plot with x/y axes, multi-series dots, and optional size encoding.

<ScatterChart
  aria-label="Latency by payload size"
  series={[{ name: "Baseline", data: [{ x: 12, y: 40 }, { x: 24, y: 55 }] }]}
  xAxisLabel="Payload (KB)"
  yAxisLabel="Latency (ms)"
/>

tree-grid.name: Tree Grid
tree-grid.description: A data table whose rows form an expandable tree, following the WAI-ARIA treegrid pattern.
tree-grid.usage:
<TreeGrid
  aria-label="Project files"
  columns={[
    { key: 'name', label: 'Name' },
    { key: 'size', label: 'Size' },
  ]}
  rows={[
    { id: 'src', name: 'src', size: '—', children: [{ id: 'app', name: 'app.ts', size: '2 KB' }] },
  ]}
/>

stack.name: Stack
stack.description: A flex primitive that stacks children along one axis with consistent spacing and alignment.

grid.name: Grid
grid.description: A grid primitive with fixed columns or responsive auto-fit tracks.

resizable.name: Resizable
resizable.description: Pointer- and keyboard-resizable panes with percentage sizing and double-click reset.

aspect-ratio.name: Aspect Ratio
aspect-ratio.description: Keeps media or content at a consistent width-to-height ratio.

app-shell.name: AppShell
app-shell.description: An application frame that places header, sidebar, main and footer regions into named grid areas.

box.name: Box
box.description: The lowest-level layout primitive: a polymorphic box with spacing props, leaving surfaces and colors to className.

center.name: Center
center.description: Centers children horizontally and vertically inside their box, with an inline option for flow content.

columns.name: Columns
columns.description: An equal-width grid column layout that keeps row alignment and collapses to fewer columns on narrow screens.

container.name: Container
container.description: Centers content in a max-width column with responsive horizontal padding and fixed size steps.

flex.name: Flex
flex.description: A flex container primitive with direction, gap, alignment and distribution props; defaults to a horizontal row.

masonry.name: Masonry
masonry.description: A CSS-columns masonry layout where unequal-height items pack tightly down each column without row gaps.

scroll-shadow.name: ScrollShadow
scroll-shadow.description: A scroll container that fades the top and bottom edges to signal that more content exists in that direction.

section.name: Section
section.description: A semantic page section with vertical rhythm spacing and an optional centered container wrap.

sticky-header.name: StickyHeader
sticky-header.description: A header that sticks to the top of its scrolling container and gains a shadow once it is stuck.

visually-hidden.name: Visually Hidden
visually-hidden.description: Hides content visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.

copy-button.name: Copy Button
copy-button.description: A button that copies a value to the clipboard and confirms with an icon swap and live feedback.

theme-toggle.name: Theme Toggle
theme-toggle.description: An icon button that toggles the dark class on the document root and reports its state.

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.description: A scroll-snap carousel with previous and next controls, dot indicators, and arrow-key support.
carousel.usage:
<Carousel label="Featured reports">
  <ReportCard title="Q1 security" />
  <ReportCard title="Q2 reliability" />
</Carousel>

collapse.name: Collapse
collapse.description: Animates a region's height to show or hide content, marking it hidden and inert while closed.

countdown-timer.name: Countdown Timer
countdown-timer.description: Counts down to a target date with a default HH:MM:SS display or a custom render prop, firing onComplete at zero.
countdown-timer.usage:
<CountdownTimer
  targetDate={launchDate}
  onComplete={openLaunch}
  completionMessage="The launch window has opened."
/>

focus-trap.name: Focus Trap
focus-trap.description: Keeps Tab and Shift+Tab focus cycling within a container and restores focus when deactivated.

highlight-text.name: Highlight Text
highlight-text.description: Wraps every case-insensitive match of a query in a styled mark element.

infinite-scroll.name: Infinite Scroll
infinite-scroll.description: Loads the next batch of content automatically when a sentinel scrolls into view via IntersectionObserver.
infinite-scroll.usage:
<InfiniteScroll
  hasMore={hasMore}
  loading={loading}
  onLoadMore={loadNextPage}
  endMessage="All caught up"
>
  <ReportRows rows={rows} />
</InfiniteScroll>

lazy-image.name: Lazy Image
lazy-image.description: Defers an image request until it nears the viewport, showing a placeholder and fading the image in on load.
lazy-image.usage:
<LazyImage
  src="/charts/signups.png"
  alt="Bar chart of quarterly signups"
  width={640}
  height={360}
/>

marquee.name: Marquee
marquee.description: Scrolls content horizontally in a seamless CSS-animation loop with pause-on-hover and reduced-motion support.
marquee.usage:
<Marquee duration={16} pauseOnHover>
  <StatusChip label="All systems operational" />
  <StatusChip label="Deploy complete" />
</Marquee>

number-ticker.name: Number Ticker
number-ticker.description: Animates a number toward its target with a requestAnimationFrame count-up and a pluggable formatter.

portal.name: Portal
portal.description: Renders children into a different DOM container, escaping overflow and stacking-context traps.

presence.name: Presence
presence.description: Keeps children mounted through their exit transition before unmounting them.

reveal.name: Reveal
reveal.description: Fades and slides children in when they scroll into the viewport via IntersectionObserver.

time-ago.name: Time Ago
time-ago.description: Renders a self-updating relative timestamp like "5 minutes ago" with the absolute time on hover.

truncated-text.name: Truncated Text
truncated-text.description: Clamps text to one or more lines with a show more/less toggle and a tooltip for the full text.
truncated-text.usage:
<TruncatedText
  text="The full audit summary that may not fit..."
  lines={3}
/>

virtual-list.name: Virtual List
virtual-list.description: Renders only the visible slice of a large fixed-height list, keeping thousands of rows scrolling smoothly.
